messages:
maria: heads-up — deploy-bot scheduled a staggered-wave for runtime 1.13.0 tonight 02:00 UTC. touches kernel batching, kv eviction, and router handshake. need api + console owners to ack interlock. @sam @tian

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: runtime-service @ 2024-11-03T02:00Z (thread 3435678901)
- image: redwood/runtime:1.13.0
- strategy: staggered-wave (10% -> 30% -> 100%)
- canary windows: 15m / 15m / observation 30m
- health hooks: neon-prom, traces, slow-query-alert

sam: quick question — is this purely runtime perf or are there protocol flags that the router/console must handle? console needs a schema bump only if proto/REST changes.

tian: infra/perf only. no protobuf/REST changes. the only protocol delta is a handshake flag that enables a batching optimization; it is backwards compatible but may cause higher tail latency if KV eviction timing shifts.

jules: console team here. we'll monitor the rollout UI and per-route latency panels. please add a short fallback window so console can accept older router versions in case we need to fall back. suggestion below.

jules: console pin suggestion:
```
# console cluster pin
router.compatible_versions:
  - v2.4.1   # preferred
  - v2.3.*   # fallback for 24h
```

maria: noted. runtime will include a handshake toggle. if we flip to handshake=v2.3-mode it disables the batching micro-optimization. runtime engineers, include a quick flip flag in the release.

kevin: ops rollback criteria proposal:
- p95 latency increase > 30% lasting > 10m
- 5xx error rate > 0.5% for > 5m
- any runtime pod OOM/restart > 2 in a shard
- KV hit-rate drop > 15% sustained for 10m
If any fires, trigger rollback and notify oncall. I've added runbook steps under /runbooks/runtime-rollback.

opsbot: dashboards: https://grafana.internal/runtime-rollouts/3435678901  | slo: https://monitoring.internal/slo/runtime-p95

sam: I've drafted release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/1.13.0
Includes: batching opt-in, kv eviction tuning knob, known regression risk for long-seq requests. note: 'console may see transient p95 blips during initial canary'.

maria: can deploy-bot attach console observers and a short blameline to the release metadata? would like the observer group to get annotated messages.

maria: deploy-bot command (proposed):
```
/deploy runtime-service image=redwood/runtime:1.13.0 strategy=staggered-wave canary=10,30,100 watch_groups=console-observers,api-oncall blameline="runtime:handshake-v1.13"
```

deploy-bot: acknowledged. will tag release and start wave at 2024-11-03T02:00Z. will stream progress to #eng-releases and tag watch groups.

tian: I'm scheduling a synthetic that stresses long-context flows against the canary at 01:30Z; will post results here. it probes KV churn and long-seq tokens.

jules: console pinned to accept router fallback for 24h; updated rollout policy and opsreview done.

sam: ack from api — we'll watch per-route latency, backpressure, and queue depths. @kevin are you oncall 01:45-05:00Z?

kevin: I'm oncall. will monitor alerts and stand ready to run rollback script. copied rollback checklist to ops runbook and tested the rollback job in staging.

maria: final preflight checklist:
- [x] release notes linked
- [x] console pin & observer groups configured
- [x] synthetic canary scheduled
- [x] rollback criteria and runbook present
- [x] oncall staffed

maria: product/security ack? @tian @jules

tian: green

jules: green :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: will post wave progress and health summaries to this thread. tagging: @console-observers @api-oncall

maria: reconvene after synthetic at 02:10Z. if anyone sees anomalies post here and escalate to /pager. thanks.
